samples.title: Slow reminder cadence to day 2 / 5 / 10
samples.summary: Legal asked to nag less often. The constant REMINDER_CADENCE_DAYS changes, so due-scan math, reminder webhooks, and audit actions shift.
samples.patch:
export const REMINDER_CADENCE_DAYS = [1, 3, 7] as const;
+export const REMINDER_CADENCE_DAYS = [2, 5, 10] as const;
samples.riskNote: Cross-layer: Service (scheduler) → Data (audit) → API-adjacent webhooks. Tests assert the old 1/3/7 list and a 4-day due count.

samples.title: Allow same-group parallel inside ORDER
samples.summary: Deal desk wants every signer in group 1 unlocked together, then group 2. resolveSigningOrder and nextEligibleSigner both encode the min-group rule.
samples.patch:
const minGroup = Math.min(...request.signers.map((s) => s.group));
+// also unlock same-group peers when any peer in the group has viewed
samples.riskNote: Create-request calls resolveSigningOrder on send. Field binding assumes signer ids stay stable. Routing tests pin the current handoff.

samples.title: Add eventId to webhook deliveries
samples.summary: Integrators need an idempotency key on signature_request.* payloads. emitWebhook writes the delivery row and the webhook.delivered audit payload.
samples.patch:
appendAudit(request.id, "webhook.delivered", "system", { event, deliveryId });
+appendAudit(request.id, "webhook.delivered", "system", { event, deliveryId, eventId });
samples.riskNote: Inbound handleInboundWebhook re-emits through emitWebhook. Reminder due-scan also triggers emit. Webhook + audit tests read the current shape.
